# Apolline

> Social media management, short-form video, ads, outreach, chatbots and websites for small businesses — one team instead of five contractors. Fixed prices, agreed upfront.

Apolline is a marketing and automation team for small businesses: social media, video, ads, marketplaces, outreach, bots, websites, documents, copywriting, design and AI tools. Clients work with us by chat, call or video. We work for a fixed price: the full price is quoted and agreed before work begins.

## Services

- **Social media**: Content plan, Posts and carousels, Stories and Reels, Captions and hashtags, Profile setup, Scheduled publishing, Comment replies
- **Video**: Ideas and scripts, Editing from your photos and footage, Animation, Voiceover, Subtitles and music, TikTok, Reels, Shorts
- **Advertising**: Ad buying in Telegram channels, Influencer ads, Paid social, Creatives and banners, Lead reports
- **Marketplaces and listings**: Dozens of listings per day, Bulk upload via XML/CSV feeds, Selling copy, Photo editing, Price updates, Product pages
- **Customers and leads**: Lead handling, Messenger conversations, Reminders and review collection
- **Outreach campaigns**: WhatsApp and Telegram, E-mail and SMS, Promos and reminders, List segmentation, Response report
- **Bots and automation**: Lead-capture chatbot, Booking bot, Auto-replies, Order notifications, CRM, spreadsheet and messenger integrations, Automated reports
- **Websites**: Text and price edits, Redesign — cleaner and more modern, Website or landing page from scratch, Lead forms and online booking, Mobile optimization, Analytics
- **Presentations and documents**: Company presentation, Commercial proposals, PDF catalogs and price lists, Letter and contract templates, Spreadsheets and reports
- **Copywriting**: Website copy, Service and product descriptions, Posts and articles, Customer emails
- **Design**: Logo and brand identity, Banners and creatives, Photo editing, Social media templates
- **AI tools**: AI copy and images, AI voiceover, AI video, Putting AI into your workflows, Team training

## FAQ

### How much does it cost?

It depends on the task and volume. We discuss your first task for free and quote the price before work starts — no surprises.

### Can I take just one service?

Yes. One task or everything at once — whatever suits you. Start small and see how we work together.

### What do I need to prepare?

Nothing special. Just describe the task in a few words — by voice or text. We'll ask any follow-up questions ourselves.

### How fast can you start?

We give timelines right after we discuss the task, before work begins. We take urgent tasks too, as long as we can do them well.

### Who will I talk to?

Directly with us — in chat, on a call or a video meeting, whatever suits you. No chain of account managers — you talk to the people doing the work.

### Do you work with small businesses?

Yes, they're our main clients: manufacturers, shops, independent pros and agencies that lack the time or people for marketing and routine work.

- [How much does a small business website cost in 2026?](https://apolline.site/blog/small-business-website-cost/): Realistic 2026 price ranges for a small business website — DIY builders, freelancers and agencies — plus yearly running costs and how to get a fixed quote.
- [Google Business Profile optimization checklist](https://apolline.site/blog/google-business-profile-optimization/): How to optimize your Google Business Profile in 2026 — categories, photos, hours, services, posts and reviews — to appear in Google Maps and local search.
- [How much does social media management cost in 2026?](https://apolline.site/blog/social-media-management-cost/): Real price ranges for social media management in 2026 — freelancers, agencies and in-house — plus what is included, hidden costs and how to avoid surprises.
- [Facebook and Instagram ads for small business: budget and first steps](https://apolline.site/blog/facebook-instagram-ads-budget/): How much a small business should spend on Meta ads (Facebook and Instagram) in 2026, how to set up a first campaign, which creatives work, and how to read the results.
- [Short-form video for small business: a practical playbook](https://apolline.site/blog/short-form-video-for-small-business/): How a small business can get customers from Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts — content ideas, a weekly workflow, hooks, length and what to measure.
- [How to get more Google reviews without breaking the rules](https://apolline.site/blog/how-to-get-more-google-reviews/): Simple, policy-safe ways for a small business to get more Google reviews — when and how to ask, ready message templates, replying to reviews and what to avoid.
- [Repeat customers with email and WhatsApp marketing](https://apolline.site/blog/repeat-customers-email-whatsapp/): How small businesses can bring past customers back with email and WhatsApp — building a list legally, segments, message ideas, automations and what to measure.
- [Outsource social media or hire in-house?](https://apolline.site/blog/outsource-social-media-vs-in-house/): Should a small business hire a social media manager or outsource to an agency? Compare cost, skills, speed and risk — with a simple checklist to decide.
- [How to build a 30-day social media content calendar](https://apolline.site/blog/social-media-content-calendar/): A step-by-step method to plan a month of social media posts in one afternoon — content pillars, posting frequency, a ready weekly template and batching tips.
- [Chatbots for small business: capture leads 24/7](https://apolline.site/blog/chatbot-for-small-business/): What a chatbot can do for a small business — answer questions, qualify leads, take bookings and orders — which messenger to choose, costs and common mistakes.
- [Cold outreach that gets replies, not spam flags](https://apolline.site/blog/cold-outreach-small-business/): How a small B2B business can run cold email and LinkedIn outreach in 2026 — targeting, deliverability, message templates, follow-ups and legal basics.
- [Marketplace listing optimization: photos, titles and copy that sell](https://apolline.site/blog/marketplace-listing-optimization/): A practical checklist to improve product listings on Amazon, Etsy and eBay — titles, keywords, images, descriptions, reviews and pricing — for small sellers.
